verdict: SIMULATION LANE PASS · RUNTIME ADOPTION NOT APPROVED

fellowExpScaleRationale.reason: The candidate preserves the cited widening shape but deliberately tests one-fortieth of the external absolute scale so the accepted first-week and early-established Everstead targets can coexist with an explicit proposed reward budget. This is a simulation choice, not approved balance.

currentLiveThroughput.sourcePolicy: fresh starting Gold plus frozen fresh Gold/hour, with one claim per day so each 24-hour offline cap is fully used; Levels, Power, Rank joins, and newly opened stages do not feed back into this deliberately static bound
deliberatelyOmittedFeedback: new Power -> later Campaign stages or Tower floors
currentLiveThroughput.sharedGoldWarning: The Companion envelope first charges the two Fellow clears required for Rank 2, then spends the remaining Gold on Companion Campaign. The separate Fellow envelope spends the full Gold on Fellow replays, so the two envelope totals still cannot be added.
currentLiveThroughput.lowerBoundPolicy: A player can keep replaying the already open stage at frozen fresh Power, so these Campaign values are conservative achievable lower bounds; they are not exact horizon forecasts.
currentLiveThroughput.unprovenGap: The simulator does not claim an exact released progression forecast until the full old-curve EXP -> Level -> Power -> Rank join -> access loop is modeled with one conserved Gold ledger.

proposedLaunchBudget.description: Cumulative account-wide raw EXP and abstract Breakthrough throughput required to test the handoff pacing targets. These values require new authored permanent reward sources before any curve can ship.

applicationOrder.exp: raw eligible EXP times one plus Collection EXP; integer-floor only for this provisional simulation
applicationOrder.power: Collection Power adds beside Might in the final Fellow bonus pool; it never multiplies an already-boosted final total
applicationOrder.earnings: Collection Earnings adds beside Oath; the report uses the fresh zero-Oath baseline
applicationOrder.facility: A normalized active facility reward uses one plus its facility-local collection bonus

collectionLedgerMigrationEvidence.policy: derive exact named-pool totals from unique claimed-entry provenance; never clamp to obsolete displayed caps

limitedEventAlternativeEvidence.policy: one mechanical entitlement across equivalent limited and permanent claims; limited cosmetic metadata remains exclusive

targetAssessment.full18BroadScenarioPrerequisite: All matrix rows labeled broad are synthetic full-18-roster evidence and require those Fellows to be recruited; they are not fresh-save roster evidence.
targetAssessment.caveat: These checks measure the provisional proposed-launch budget only. Released-mechanics throughput is reported separately as frozen-fresh static bounds and does not satisfy the same budget.

findings.text: Released Fellow EXP throughput is orders of magnitude below the provisional first-week budget. Permanent authored EXP sources and their claim behavior must be designed before this curve can ship.

The provisional day-one focused budget yields 313,664 Fellow Power and makes all 10 released Broken Roads stages Power-reachable against the final 144,000 requirement. Any runtime reward plan must sequence EXP behind story/stage gates or target post-current content; released requirements remain frozen and were not repriced.
Breakthrough requirements are normalized simulation units only. Exact existing materials or fixed bundles, acquisition rates, and manual claim presentation remain unresolved.

Released-mechanics horizon values are conservative frozen-fresh Campaign bounds plus explicitly conditional Tower upper envelopes, not a dynamic current-live forecast. A full old-curve EXP, Level, Power, Rank-join, access, target-rotation, and conserved-Gold simulation remains unimplemented.

Broad matrix rows use a synthetic full 18-Fellow roster. Fresh-save early breadth is separately probed across the six actually joined Fellows; the Rank-crossing recruitment timeline remains unmodeled.
The released Fellow Expedition exhausts one distinct Fellow per stage, limiting the 18-Fellow roster to Stage 18 even though 50 requirements exist.

Old cumulative EXP is table-dependent. Runtime migration needs authenticated lineage, exact rational progress preservation, a separate post-cap bank, and a free manual Companion Level-100 legacy Breakthrough.
The stale Appendix C Broken Roads prose table was rejected in favor of the frozen Phase 24A runtime table; no existing stage was repriced.
All mandatory reachability remains testable at zero Collection. The +1,000% stress rows measure long-horizon headroom and do not create a lifetime cap.

trueHighEconomyAt1000PercentCollection.applicationOrder: pre-Oath Gold/hour * (1 + Oath bonus + Collection Earnings); never multiply the already-Oath-boosted total
